added_failure_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own arms: gate-base.log and gate-head.log both complete with 22 FAILED ids and the two sorted id sets diff to empty, so no failure id is added by this change.

findings.text: two of the three assertions in the query test cannot fail for the defect they claim to guard - "RENAMED_TO*1..12" is already in the pre-existing OPTIONAL MATCH clause of the detect query and "sn.source_path" is in its WHERE clause, so only "lineage_rename_explains" discriminates; an existence-only mutation (EXISTS replaced by a literal true) keeps this test green.

the rename-only branch re-stamps the name snapshot and returns without calling _repoint_source (source_refresh.py:441, called at :538), so the producing source stays anchored to the superseded identity and its captured src.dd_path is left stale; a source that carries dd_path therefore re-reports the same lineage rename on every startup instead of converging.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log records 4 failed of 7 under the three-line revert, so the rename guard genuinely reddens, but tests/standard_names/test_source_refresh_rename_lineage.py:240-241 assert substrings that hold without the flag.
justifications.evidence: gate-base.log and gate-head.log both end in a completed run with EXIT=1 and the same 22 FAILED ids, but gate-head.log's header pins revision 55af2a7ff+working-tree rather than the commit, so the exact tree the head arm measured is only recoverable by hashing drift-arms-ufqCWD/head.
justifications.fit: source_refresh.py:191-240 keeps the module's dict-of-deltas idiom and its docstring style, and no symbol or comment carries a plan label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/source_refresh.py:386-390 keeps a lineage-explained source_path delta out of requires_steering, and dry-run-after.log records 84 detected / 13 renamed against 1061 / 0 before.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no new capability owner; it extends _RESOLVE_SOURCE_TERMINAL (source_refresh.py:53) and _source_deltas (source_refresh.py:191), and a search over imas_codex for another snapshot-drift owner found only graph_source_bindings.py:2745, whose removed-path resolution is a different mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 55af2a7ff..6742a8b60 is one of the three declared write paths; the per-source comparison at source_refresh.py:53-75 exceeds the goal sentence but is what the done-when's expected fall from ~1065 requires.
